The Sample Trade Ordinance, 1975 ( ORDINANCE NO. 7 OF 1975 )

1. Words used in this Ordinance shall have the same meaning as in the Sample Licensing Act, 1950 (Act No. XII of 1950).

2. A trader shall not sell goods without a licence under the Act No. XII of 1950.

3. The Government may, by notification, exempt any class of traders.
